title: Repeating Figure Grid
description: A 4x6 grid of identical digital artworks showing a green-skinned woman with long red hair wearing a vibrant orange and black patterned outfit. Each panel displays her in slightly different poses against a surreal background with floating translucent orbs, a small house, and a dark atmospheric setting.
prompt: A green-skinned female figure with long flowing red hair, wearing a detailed orange and black patterned wide-leg outfit, standing in various poses. Surreal background features a small house, large translucent floating spheres with purple and blue tones, dark misty atmosphere, consistent character design repeated across a grid, digital painting style with smooth shading and atmospheric lighting.
